fees.name: Estate plan for one person
fees.scope: A will, an enduring power of attorney and an appointment of a medical treatment decision maker, with one advice meeting, one round of changes and one signing appointment.

fees.name: Estate plan for a couple
fees.scope: Wills that mirror each other, and an enduring power of attorney and medical treatment decision maker appointment for each of you, at one advice meeting and one signing appointment.

fees.name: Single will
fees.scope: A will leaving your estate to the people you name, with up to two specific gifts, your executors and a guardian for young children if you need one, one round of changes and a signing appointment at which it is signed and witnessed correctly.

fees.name: Wills for a couple
fees.scope: Two wills that mirror each other, on the same terms as the single will, prepared together.

fees.name: Enduring power of attorney
fees.scope: Per person. Advice on choosing your attorneys and when their power starts, the document for financial and personal matters, and a signing appointment at which it is signed and witnessed as the law requires.
offer_names: Enduring power of attorney, per person
fees.short: Enduring power of attorney, per person

fees.name: Appointment of a medical treatment decision maker
fees.scope: Per person. Advice on choosing the person who will make medical decisions if you cannot, the appointment itself, and a signing appointment at which it is witnessed as the law requires.
offer_names: Appointment of a medical treatment decision maker, per person
fees.short: Medical treatment decision maker appointment, per person

fees.name: Will with a testamentary trust for one person
fees.scope: Advice on whether a testamentary trust suits you and a will that sets up one standard discretionary trust for your children or other beneficiaries. More than one trust, or a business, company or family trust to deal with, costs more, and your fee is confirmed in writing after the first meeting.
fees.short: Will with a testamentary trust, one person

fees.name: Wills with testamentary trusts for a couple
fees.scope: Two wills that mirror each other, each setting up one standard testamentary trust, at one advice meeting and one signing appointment, with the same things costing more as for one person.
fees.short: Wills with testamentary trusts, a couple

fees.name: Probate application
fees.scope: For a straightforward estate, meaning an original will that was properly signed, executors who are able to apply, assets in Victoria and no caveat or challenge. We prepare and file the application, publish the notice of intention to apply and pay its fee, answer the Probate Office's routine questions and send you the grant. The Court's rules set a scale for how much of a lawyer's charge for obtaining a grant can be paid from the estate, so how our fee will be met is confirmed in writing before we start.

fees.name: Letters of administration
fees.scope: For a straightforward estate where there is no will, the person applying has the first right to do so and nobody disputes who inherits. Everything in the probate application, plus working out who is entitled and obtaining any consents needed. It assumes the Court does not ask for a surety guarantee, which it can require in some cases.

fees.name: Divorce application, joint
fees.scope: Checking that you can apply, preparing the joint application, helping you both sign it, filing it and dealing with the Court until the divorce order is made, where you have been separated for at least 12 months and did not live under the one roof in that time.

fees.name: Divorce application, sole
fees.scope: Everything in the joint application, plus arranging service on your spouse, the affidavit proving service and attending the hearing if the Court requires it, where your spouse can be served in Australia and does not oppose the divorce.

fees.name: Consent orders for an agreed property settlement
fees.scope: Advice on the agreement you have reached, the application for consent orders and the proposed orders, including splitting one superannuation interest and transferring one property, the notice the Court's rules require to the super fund, filing and the sealed orders. It assumes you have exchanged full financial disclosure and no company, trust or business is involved.
terms: consent orders for an agreed property settlement

fees.name: Consent orders for agreed parenting arrangements
fees.scope: Advice on the arrangements you have agreed, the application and the proposed parenting orders, filing and the sealed orders, where there are no family violence or child safety concerns for the Court to look into.
terms: consent orders for agreed parenting arrangements

fees.name: Consent orders for property and parenting together
fees.scope: One application for consent orders covering both an agreed property settlement and agreed parenting arrangements, with everything the two prices above include and on the same assumptions as each.
fees.short: Consent orders, property and parenting together

fees.name: Parenting plan
fees.scope: A written plan built from arrangements you have already agreed, covering regular time, holidays and special days, changeovers and decisions, with advice on what a plan does and does not do, including that it cannot be enforced the way court orders can, and one round of changes. Further rounds of changes cost more.

fees.name: Binding financial agreement
fees.scope: Per party. The advice the law requires for the agreement to be binding, drafting from terms you have agreed, one round of changes with the other party's lawyer, the certificate of independent legal advice and signing. A business, company or trust, more than two properties or negotiating the terms costs more.

fees.name: Advice on a binding financial agreement drafted by the other party
fees.scope: Per party. Reviewing an agreement the other party's lawyer has prepared, the advice the law requires before you sign it, a meeting to go through it and the certificate of independent legal advice. Negotiating changes, or an agreement involving a business, company or trust, costs more.
fees.short: Advice on an agreement the other party drafted

fees.name: Lease review for a tenant
fees.scope: A written summary of the terms that matter, including rent reviews, outgoings, options, fit out and make good, assignment and guarantees, with recommended changes and a call to go through it. For a retail lease it covers the landlord's disclosure statement. A non-standard lease or more than one premises costs more.

fees.name: Company set up
fees.scope: Registering one proprietary company with up to two directors and shareholders, with its constitution, consents, register of members, share certificates and first resolutions, and an ABN and GST registration if needed. ASIC's registration fee is passed on at cost and carries no GST.

fees.name: Shareholder agreement
fees.scope: For one private company with up to three shareholders who have agreed the commercial terms: decisions, share transfers, deadlock, exit and valuation, restraints and disputes, with one round of changes. More shareholders, investors or employee shares cost more.

fees.name: Terms of trade
fees.scope: One set of terms for a business selling goods or services, covering orders, payment and credit, delivery, retention of title and liability, drafted to work with the Australian Consumer Law, with one round of changes. Terms for more than one business, or an industry code to follow, cost more.

fees.name: Review of a contract to buy a business
fees.scope: A written report on the main risks in the contract and the vendor's disclosure, including price, stock and equipment, the vendor's restraint, employees, conditions and settlement, with a call to go through it. A franchise or a purchase of shares costs more.

fees.name: Letter of demand
fees.scope: A letter on the firm's letterhead to one debtor for an undisputed debt, setting out what is owed, any interest the contract allows and a deadline to pay.

charges.about: What the courts and ASIC charge, as each body publishes it. These are not the firm's fees. Re-read each source before valid_to passes, change the amounts and the dates here, and run scripts/fees.py apply. The check fails once valid_to has passed.
